newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST - Polish banks see end-96 CPI at 18.84 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Polish banks see end-96 CPI at 18.84 pct.

text.p: Inflation expectations among Polish banks rose in December after easing slightly in November, a monthly Reuter poll of the 25 biggest banks showed on Tuesday.
Banks predicted on average year-on-year inflation for the end of 1996 to be 18.84 percent, up from 18.71 percent last month and the government's prediction of between 17.9 and 18.2 percent.
In December 1995, banks had on average expected inflation in December 1996 to fall to 19.58 percent, with a forecast range between 17 and 21 percent.
Year-on-year October inflation was flat at 19.5 percent and official data for November will be announced by the Central Statistical Office on December 16.
Banks' average forecast for monthly December inflation was 1.41 percent, with a range between 0.90 and 1.70 percent.
Banks predicted year-on-year inflation in December 1997 at an average 16.35 percent, with the range from 15.2 to 18.0 percent.
